AN EDITORIAL SYSTEM

Useful stories.
A recognizable voice.

Plan content around everyday needs, category discovery and digital confidence. The supplied mix is an initial planning hypothesis, not a performance benchmark.

THE VISUAL GUIDE

The content mix, at a glance.

100%DIGITAL CONTENT
35%

Everyday utility

Household lists, helpful routines and practical planning.

25%

Category discovery

Useful category information based on actual catalogue content.

20%

Family & culture

Regional moments, thoughtful relevance and local language.

10%

Digital service & trust

Search guidance, availability explanations and confirmed support information.

10%

Approved campaigns

A verified message with valid dates and an appropriate destination.

Proposed planning mix. Adjust using actual channel results.

THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

Guidelines in practice

Proposed digital standards
01

Brief

Record audience, objective, channel, region and one central message.

02

Localize

Transcreate meaning rather than translate word for word. Have a regional editor proof the final creative.

03

Review

Use actual channel results to adjust the mix. Record what worked and archive expired campaign material.
